name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: {{gha:github.workflow}}-{{gha:github.ref}}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Generated by the Launchbed tooling/github-actions addon.
# Action pins are commit SHAs verified on 2026-11-16 via git ls-remote.
# JDK and SDK package IDs come from docs/compatibility.md via the generator.
jobs:
  android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-java@d1374f8ac74474200d16ef8ecee22c7ae7a51880 # v6.3.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"
      - uses: gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@be39fa834029ff78f1a44aa3bb0819b8fc2bd8fd # v4.0.4
      - name: Install SDK packages
        run: sdkmanager "platforms;android-{{compileSdkPackage}}" "build-tools;{{buildToolsVersion}}" "platform-tools"
      - name: Unit tests
        run: ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest
      - name: Assemble debug APK
        run: ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
      - name: Lint
        run: ./gradlew :app:lintDebug
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-debug
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
